metadata.title: Unfolding key factors of resilience in ICT cognitive-motivational engagement: Global evidence from machine learning techniques

design_fields.q1_rationale: Plausible values are not applicable because the dependent variable is a binary classification derived from ICT engagement questionnaire responses, not a PV-based cognitive achievement score.
design_fields.q2_rationale: The study uses PISA 2018 microdata but does not mention whether sampling weights were applied in the analysis.
design_fields.q3_rationale: The study models individual students without using multilevel modelling or accounting for school clustering.
design_fields.q4_rationale: The study mentions internal validation methods but does not provide evidence of validation on data from another country, another cycle, or an entirely external dataset.
